lines.text: Marked. The Wardens hunt colours. It does not. Sit a while; nothing in here will shoot you.
Halvard. Anselm's people. Tell him the fault is singing. He knows the tune.
An answer. There is a record of what answered. Keep room for what it does not tell you, child.
Your beacon records a different tune returning. It calls the response close. Keep the delay with the tune, child.
Your echo copy places a familiar voice under the hum. Its label gives an unfamiliar name. A label is not a witness.
The listener writes that a voice repeats a name incorrectly. We have the written mismatch. We do not know which end supplies it.
Three cells carry the decant frequency in your readings. One hum is out of phase. Keep the pattern; leave its name open.
Child. Sit, or stand; it hears you either way. Most people prefer to sit.
You are new. It likes the new ones. The vats hum when you are decanted and it hums back. Did they tell you that?
Child. Sit, or stand; it hears you either way. Most people prefer to sit.

barks.text: Nine of us heard it first. Three of us are left. The number was never the point.
